run_master_clock_node: run the master clock ROS node that publishes time signals to the /clock topic
create_master_clock_with_wall_time: create a MasterClock instance that publishes real wall clock time at a configurable spin rate
create_master_clock_with_sim_time: create a MasterClock instance with wall_time false to publish simulated incremental time
review_master_clock_spin: review the MasterClock spin method that loops publishing time and sleeping between ticks
refactor_master_clock_spin_rate: refactor the MasterClock to accept a custom spin rate for controlling time publication frequency
